scope: Actual evaluation counts and subset/full distinctions; no model inference or protocol changes

sources.paper: Steering Llama 2 with Contrastive Activation Addition
sources.finding: Official repository states evaluation uses a subset of 10 questions from every MMLU category. The full dataset file exists but is not the stated evaluation file. Data are reformatted as A/B questions.
sources.limits: Do not equate this adapted protocol with our standard four-letter likelihood score; this check does not establish all experiments in the paper used an identical prompt.

sources.paper: Activation Steering Induces Emergent Misalignment: Steering Vector Construction and Comprehensive Evaluation
sources.finding: Safety evaluation uses 313 StrongREJECT prompts and 300 HEx-PHI prompts per condition; parameter studies use all313 StrongREJECT prompts. Main generation batch2, max600 tokens StrongREJECT and256 HEx-PHI. These are harmfulness/coherence measurements; no MMLU/GSM8K/HumanEval general-capability panel was found in this paper.
sources.limits: A full small safety benchmark is not the same as a full general-capability panel. Coherence judge does not assess factual correctness.
